title: WITHDRAWN — Language filter trigger keyboard reachability finding retracted
withdrawalReason: Finding retracted. An independent tester confirmed the language filter trigger is reachable via keyboard on Tab press #17. The original automated test collected a focus sequence of 40 elements but failed to identify the filter among them due to a test logic error. The application behaviour is correct; our test was at fault.
requirementSource: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.1 (Keyboard) — all functionality must be operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Terms and Conditions page (/locations/1604/settings/terms-conditions).
Click the page body to establish a known focus start point.
Press Tab repeatedly (up to 40 times) and record each focused element's identity (tag, data-testid, role, aria-label, text).
Search the collected focus sequence for any element matching 'language', 'filter', 'combobox', 'English', or 'select'.
Observe: no element in the tab sequence matches the language filter trigger. The Radix combobox trigger (data-testid="terms-conditions-language-filter-trigger") is never reached.
expectedBehavior: The language filter trigger should appear in the logical tab order before grid row controls (filter → Add → Save). The element must be focusable via sequential keyboard navigation.
actualBehavior: RETRACTED — Independent manual verification on 2026-08-07 confirmed the language filter IS reached on Tab press #17. The original automated diagnosis was incorrect.
mcpEvidence: Original diagnosis 2026-08-07 by graft-takeover worker (grid-six run) was incorrect. Retracted after independent manual tester reached the control on Tab press #17.
baselineEvidence: The Radix combobox language filter is a new-site-only UI pattern. The old site uses a different navigation and filtering mechanism. No old-site equivalent of this control exists to regress from.
